data.description: Rows of one leaf route of the v2 tree: period, facet columns, the requested data columns and their units.

route.desc: route path (electricity/retail-sales, seds, petroleum/pri/spt) or catalog alias

data.desc: data columns, list (default ["value"] or the route's main column, e.g. price for retail-sales)

state.desc: state USPS code, name or FIPS (or a list, or US): fills the route's state facet

msn.desc: SEDS series codes (TETCB, TETCD, ...): fills seriesId

frequency.desc: annual, quarterly, monthly, weekly, daily, hourly (what the route offers; default its default)

start.desc: first period: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-QN, matching the frequency

routes.description: Child routes of a route ('' = the top of the tree): id, name, description.

route.desc: route path; empty for the root

facets.description: Facets (filters) a leaf route offers: id, description.

metadata.description: One row: name, description, frequencies, facets, data columns with units, start and end period.

facet_values.description: Values one facet takes on a route (stateid -> CA, TX, ...; sectorid -> RES, COM, ...).

facet.desc: facet id from the facets endpoint

retail_sales.name: Electricity sales to ultimate customers
retail_sales.description: electricity retail price (cents per kWh), sales (million kWh), revenue (million dollars), customers by state and sector (RES, COM, IND, TRA, OTH, ALL); 2001-

power_operations.name: Electric power operations (annual and monthly)
power_operations.description: generation, fuel consumption, stocks, receipts, cost by location (state), sector and fuel type

power_emissions_by_state.name: Emissions from power plants by state and fuel
power_emissions_by_state.description: SO2, NOx, CO2 (thousand metric tons) and rates (lbs per MWh) from conventional and CHP plants; 1990-

seds.name: State Energy Data System (SEDS)
seds.description: state energy production, consumption, prices and expenditures by source and sector, annual 1960-; series by MSN code (seriesId), state by stateId

total_energy.name: Total energy (Monthly Energy Review)
total_energy.description: U.S. totals: production, consumption, prices, emissions by MSN series

steo.name: Short-Term Energy Outlook
steo.description: forecasts and history, monthly to two years ahead (seriesId)

aeo_2026.name: Annual Energy Outlook 2026
aeo_2026.description: long-term projections to 2050 by scenario, table, series and region (other editions: aeo/2025, aeo/2023 ...)

spot_prices.name: Petroleum spot prices
spot_prices.description: crude oil (WTI RWTC, Brent RBRTE) and product spot prices; daily, weekly, monthly, annual; 1986-

gasoline_diesel_retail.name: Retail gasoline and diesel prices
gasoline_diesel_retail.description: weekly pump prices by area and grade (series EMM_EPMR_PTE_NUS_DPG regular U.S., EMD_EPD2D_PTE_NUS_DPG diesel U.S.); 1990-

crude_production.name: Crude oil production
crude_production.description: field production by state and PAD district

crude_imports_by_origin.name: Crude oil imports by origin and destination
crude_imports_by_origin.description: quantity (thousand barrels) by origin country, destination, grade; 2009-

natural_gas_prices.name: Natural gas prices
natural_gas_prices.description: wellhead, citygate, residential, commercial, industrial, electric power prices by area (process, duoarea)

natural_gas_production.name: Natural gas production
natural_gas_production.description: gross withdrawals and production by area

coal_consumption_quality.name: Coal consumption and quality
coal_consumption_quality.description: receipts, consumption, stocks (short tons), price (dollars per short ton), heat, sulfur and ash content by location and sector

co2_emissions_aggregates.name: State CO2 emissions by sector and fuel (deprecated: see SEDS)
co2_emissions_aggregates.description: energy-related CO2, million metric tons, 1970-2022; EIA marks it deprecated
